## Description {#details}

<p>This file declares the IRTranslator pass.</p>


<p>This pass is responsible for translating LLVM IR into MachineInstr. It uses target hooks to lower the ABI but aside from that, the pass generated code is generic. This is the default translator used for GlobalISel.</p>
